failure_modes: One calendar year may not represent other monetary-policy or inflation regimes.
CMT values are theoretical constant-maturity par yields, not transaction prices.
A persistent inverted curve does not establish causation, future returns, timing ability, or a profitable trade.
The selected 2-year and 10-year tenors do not describe every part of the yield curve.
hypothesis: On the untouched 2023 Treasury holdout, the 2-year CMT yield will exceed the 10-year CMT yield on at least 80% of complete published observations.

bias_controls: The 2023 source snapshot must not enter the project before this specification is committed.
The entire 2023 period is a single untouched holdout; no training or parameter selection is performed.
Only one decision metric and one threshold are permitted.
Every complete published observation is used with no calendar interpolation or missing-value imputation.
The result describes contemporaneous slope structure and cannot be represented as prediction or tradable alpha.

next_experiment: If supported, preregister one temporal slope hypothesis on a new untouched holdout; if falsified, preserve the failure and reassess the regime premise.

result.interpretation: The untouched holdout supports the preregistered persistent-inversion threshold. This describes slope structure, not prediction or alpha.
